current_assessment: Reaction wheel 2 bearing is degrading. RW-2 has been spun down and the spacecraft has transitioned to magnetic torquer attitude control. Pointing precision has degraded from 0.3 arcsec to approximately 4.2 arcsec. Sun-pointing error has increased to 0.42°, reducing solar input by approximately 12%. Fine science pointing is currently unavailable.

predicted_failures.failure_mode: Magnetic torquer saturation — attitude control authority loss
predicted_failures.estimated_time_to_failure: 14-24 hours near Jupiter magnetic field gradient

predicted_failures.failure_mode: Solar input reduction from sustained off-sun pointing causing battery depletion
Science observations unusable due to pointing instability

cascading_risks: Poor sun-pointing compounds power margin already stressed by RW power draw changes
Magnetic torquer authority insufficient for large attitude maneuvers near Jupiter
RW-2 mechanical failure (seizure) could generate debris or vibration affecting other wheels
Reduced pointing precision affects HGA tracking, potentially degrading comms link
recommended_actions: Command RW-2 full spin-down and lock immediately to prevent seizure
Bias attitude to best available sun-pointing using RW 1, 3, 4 plus magnetic torquers
Suspend high-precision science observations until RW redundancy restored
Increase solar array tracking frequency to compensate for reduced pointing precision
Upload updated attitude control gains optimised for 3-wheel plus torquer configuration

PRIORITY REPORT — ASTERIA-7 T+09:42

FDIR EVENT: Reaction wheel 2 bearing degradation detected. RW-2 spun down. Magnetic torquer backup engaged.

CURRENT STATUS: Degraded attitude control. Pointing precision reduced from 0.3 to 4.2 arcsec. Solar input reduced 12% due to off-sun pointing.

PRIMARY RISK: Magnetic torquer saturation possible in 14-24 hours in current magnetic field environment. Solar power margin reduced.

ACTIONS TAKEN BY FDIR: RW-2 isolated, magnetic torquer mode engaged, attitude stabilised at degraded precision.

GROUND RECOMMENDATIONS: (1) Upload 3-wheel attitude control parameters within next contact window. (2) Suspend precision science for minimum 48 hours. (3) Evaluate RW-2 reactivation feasibility after 4-hour cooldown.

MISSION IMPACT: Science collection suspended. Power margin reduced. No immediate safety risk.
